A picture card linking to a category, with how many pages are in it. Used on the directory pages ([[Characters]], [[Organizations]], [[Server events]]); it looks like the directory buttons on the [[Main Page|front page]]. 

{{Directory card | label = Criminal | category = Criminal characters | image = CardBackground_Criminal.png }}
{{Directory card | label = Civilian | category = Civilian characters }}
{| class="wikitable" ! Value !! What it does |- | category || The category it links to and counts. |- | label || The words on the card (default: the category's name). |- | image || The picture, as on the front page: art on the right, roughly 3:1. Until it's uploaded, the card uses fallback if given, then the default background, [[:File:CardBackground_Default.png]]. |- | fallback || Optional: a picture to use before the default, until image exists. |- | link || A page to link to instead of the category. |} Put the cards inside
…
, which lays them out in a grid. [[Category:Help templates]]

Every character on the Let's RP Wiki. Pick a group below, or find a character in the full list. Click a column heading to sort the list. == Browse == === By status ===
{{Directory card | label = Active | category = Active characters | image = CardBackground_Active.png }} {{Directory card | label = Inactive | category = Inactive characters | image = CardBackground_Inactive.png }} {{Directory card | label = Deceased | category = Deceased characters | image = CardBackground_Deceased.png }}
=== By focus ===
{{Directory card | label = Civilian | category = Civilian characters | image = CardBackground_Civilian.png }} {{Directory card | label = Criminal | category = Criminal characters | image = CardBackground_Criminal.png }} {{Directory card | label = Public Sector | category = Public Sector characters | image = CardBackground_PublicSector.png }}
== Add a character == Type the character's name to start their page, with the infobox and headings ready to fill in.
type=create preload=Template:Infobox character/preload placeholder=Character name buttonlabel=Create character page break=no width=30
== All characters ==
{{#dpl: |category = Characters |ordermethod = title |count = 500 |include = {Infobox character}:status:focus:occupation:affiliation:played_by:version |table = class="wikitable sortable",Character,Status,Focus,Occupation,Affiliation,Played by,Version |tablerow = %%,%%,%%,%%,%%,%% |noresultsheader = No characters yet. Add the first one above! |suppresserrors = true }}
__NOTOC__
